about_the_game:
Part city builder, part retro vehicle shooter. Tear down the ruins of the old world and use what you find to build a settlement. Rescue survivors from the wastes. Defend your people against waves of attacks from the rogue AI that ruined the old world. Procedural levels and random build order make every run unique.

Carve your way through the post-post-apocalyptic sprawl to find valuable resources and rescue settlers.

Every building you construct and how you position it affects your settlement's chance of survival.

The dark remnants of humanity’s past are not friendly.

Work together with your community to restore each wasteland to its natural glory.
